A lookup-table VRT decoding an 8-bit coded raster (adapter).

gdal_decode_vrt.Rd

Every band of src becomes a Float32 band whose ComplexSource maps each code through table (<LUT>), with nodata masked (<NODATA>) and NaN as the band's nodata: any GDAL read, warp or resampling of the VRT sees decoded values, and averaging averages them, the order a nonlinear code needs. The XML is written directly (no gdalbuildvrt, which refuses south-up sources); the geotransform, CRS and band descriptions are the source's. The read path for every source lazy_dataset() decodes; an aligned read applies the same table itself (.gdal_read_decoded()).

Usage

gdal_decode_vrt(vrt, src, lo, table, nodata = numeric(0))

Arguments

vrt

Output VRT path.

src

The coded raster (Byte or Int8 bands).

lo

The code of table[[1L]].

table

Decoded value of each code from lo; NaN entries (the nodata code) are left out of the LUT.

nodata

Length-0 or length-1 code to mask.

Value

vrt.
